settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1–3 business days and usually arrive in 5–9 business days in the US. You'll get a tracking link by email.

settings.question: Will it arrive before Christmas?
settings.answer: Order by December 12 for US delivery before December 25.

settings.question: How does buy 2, save 15% work?
settings.answer: Add any 2 or more items to your bag and 15% comes off automatically at checkout. No code needed.

settings.question: What if I need to return something?
settings.answer: Contact us within 30 days of delivery. If an item arrives damaged or wrong, send a photo and we'll replace or refund it free.
